name: What should I look for in a metal roof replacement estimate to ensure it's comprehensive?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a metal roof replacement estimate to ensure it's comprehensive?

acceptedAnswer.text: When reviewing a metal roof replacement estimate, look for a clear breakdown of material costs, labor fees, permits, and waste disposal. A comprehensive estimate from Discounted Roofing Co. should specify the type of metal, color, gauge, and any warranty information. It should also detail the scope of work, including tear-off, decking repairs, underlayment, and flashing, ensuring all potential costs are transparently listed without hidden fees.
acceptedAnswer.description: A comprehensive estimate should detail material costs, labor, permits, waste disposal, and the full scope of work, including material specifications.
